class.name: CurvePointItem
class.brief_description: A single (x, y) point of a linearly-interpolated characteristic curve.
class.description: [CurvePointItem] is shared by every FIZ table section that reduces to a two-column X/Y table (e.g. [code]Pmaxlist[/code], [code]DMList[/code], [code]HTCList[/code], [code]V2NMAXList[/code]). The owning property's documentation states which section and which axes [member x]/[member y] represent.
